label: J. M. E. McTaggart, The Unreality of Time…: McTaggart describes a further A series introduced to…
locator: The Unreality of Time, paragraph beginning 'The difficulty may be put in another way'
interpretation: This is his proposed viciousness criterion for this particular explanatory regress. It does not establish that a second index necessarily is another objectively changing A series, that all infinite hierarchies are contradictory, or that an unbounded temporal past is impossible. Those bridges remain open. Source reading in prose only; no new Lean declaration or result.
